title: Is Oracle Pruning the True Oracle?
abstract: arXiv:2412.00143v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Oracle pruning, which selects unimportant weights by minimizing the pruned train loss, has served as the foundation for most neural network pruning methods for over thirty-five years, while few (if any) have thought about how much the foundation really holds. This paper, for the first time, attempts to systematically examine its validity on deep neural networks through empirical correlation analyses and provides meta-framework reflections on the field of neural network pruning. Specifically, this paper focuses on the pruning algorithms with three stages: training, pruning, and retraining. We analyze the correlation in model performance before and after the retraining stage. translated_abstract: Oracle剪枝通过最小化剪枝后的训练损失来选择不重要的权重，三十多年来一直作为大多数神经网络剪枝方法的理论基础，然而很少有人（甚至没有人）思考过这一基础究竟有多可靠。本文首次尝试通过实证相关性分析系统地检验其在深度神经网络上的有效性，并对神经网络剪枝领域提供元框架层面的反思。具体而言，本文聚焦于包含训练、剪枝和重训练三个阶段的剪枝算法，分析了重训练阶段前后模型性能之间的相关性。本文在广泛的模型范围（LeNet5、VGG、ResNets、ViT、MLLM）和数据集（MNIST、CIFAR10/CIFAR100、ImageNet-1K、MLLM数据）上开展了大量实验（共训练了3.7万个模型）。对于大规模实验，由于……本文采用了近似Oracle剪枝。
tldr: 本文首次通过训练3.7万个模型的大规模实证相关性分析，系统检验了作为神经网络剪枝领域三十五年理论基础的正向剪枝准则在深度神经网络上的有效性，并对剪枝领域进行了元框架层面的反思。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic empirical examination of the validity of oracle pruning—the foundation of neural network pruning methods for over thirty-five years—through correlation analyses across 37K trained models, diverse architectures, and datasets, along with meta-framework reflections on the field of neural network pruning.
